title: Juicy Umami Kenyan Meat Tagliere
description: A date-night dish featuring the bold flavors of Italy and Kenya, served on a rustic tagliere.
instructions: Season the beef strips with Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Sear the beef strips in coconut oil until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a baking sheet and roast for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, roast the beef bones in the oven for 5 minutes to enhance the broth.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the chopped onion, ginger, and lemongrass in a little coconut oil until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked beef strips and bones to the pot, along with the beef broth and red wine vinegar.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the ghee and maple syrup to the pot, stirring to combine.
Simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes, then season with salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley and thyme, and serve on a rustic tagliere.
Deglaze the pan with a little red wine vinegar and ghee, then serve immediately.
Serve at once, garnished with additional parsley and thyme if desired.
